book.name: Mariko
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mariko

content: Yeesu arahorya omuutu wa amasaambwa
Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye, bhakahika kumwaambuko gwe Enyaanza ya Gariraaya, mukyaaro kya Abhagerasi.
Hano Yeesu yiikiri mubhwaato, omuutu wuno yaari atiirirwe amasaambwa amabhi yarwiiri mumabhigi ge eziimbiihira,
akagya ku Yeesu.
Omuutu wuyo ahiikara muziimbiihira. Yaari ne eziinguru, ataari ariho wowoosi wuno akanagya kumubhoha naabhe kwe eminyororo.
Bhaari bhamubhohiri kaaru ne eminyororo kumaguru ne ebhiraangʼani kumabhoko, nawe akatina bhyoosi. Ataari ariho omuutu wuno akunagya kumuhiza.
Eriibhaga ryoosi obhutiku no omwiisi yaari kuziimbiihira na mubhiguru, aratema ekituri no okwiikebhakebha kwa amagina.
Hano omuutu wuyo yamuruuzi Yeesu kwa kure, akamuryaarira, akamuhigamira.
Akatema ekituri kwiiraka ikuru akabhuga, “Awe Yeesu Omwaana wa Taatabhugya Wuno Ari Iguru we Ebhigiro Bhyoosi, ona ngʼanaki neenye? Ndakwiisasaama kwe eriina rya Taatabhugya kubha otaninyaakya!”
Yeesu akamurora omuutu wurya, akaribhuurira, “Awe eriisaambwa eriibhi, noorwe kumuutu wuno!”
Yeesu akaribhuurya, “Eriina ryaazo ni weewi?” Rikamukyoora, “Eriina ryaane ni Ihizo, kwo okubha etwe ni bhaaru kumuutu wuno.”
Eriisaambwa rirya rikamwiisasaama kaaru kubha, atagaheebha ahagiro hayo.
Kwaari ne eriihizo ikuru rye eziimbiizi, rino ryaari rikuriisya embarika we ekiguru.
Niho amasaambwa gayo gakamwiisasaama Yeesu, “Otwiikirirye, tusikire muziimbiizi zirya.”

Yeesu akagiikirirya. Ambe, amasaambwa gayo gakamurwaku omuutu wurya, gakazisikira eziimbiizi. Hayohayo, eriihizo ryoosi rikahiriingita kwa bhwaangu kumuhiriingito muhaari, rikasikira munyaanza no okukwa. Eziimbiizi ziyo zyaari zirahika bhikwe bhibhiri (2,000).
Abhariisya bhe eziimbiizi zirya bhakaryaara, bhakaraarika amangʼana gayo mwiiboma na mumigye gya haguhi. Abhaatu bhakaaza, okubha bhiirorere abheene gano gaatuukiri.

Hano bhaahikiri ku Yeesu, bhakamurora omuutu wuno yaari atiirirwe ne eriihizo rya amasaambwa amabhi yiikeeri, yiibhohiri emyeenda, na ana amangʼeeni goosi, wuno akabhirikirwa Ihizo, kyaamwe bhakoobhoha bhukongʼu.
Bhano bhaaruuzi gano gaamubhweeni wuno yaari atiirirwe na amasaambwa amabhi wurya ne eziimbiizi, bhakabha bharabhabhuurira abhaatu abhaandi amangʼana gayo.
Niho abhaatu bhayo bhakataanga okumwiisasaama Yeesu arwe mukyaaro kyaabhu.
Hano Yeesu yasikiiri mubhwaato, omuutu wuno yaari atiirirwe na amasaambwa akamwiisasaama Yeesu kubha, amwiikirirye agye hamwe neewe.
Nawe, Yeesu ataamwiikiriirye, akamubhuurira, “Noogye yiika weenyu, obhabhuurire amangʼana amakuru gano Omukuru akukoreeri na kyeego akuroreeri ebhigoongi.”
Kyaamwe, omuutu wurya akatanura, akataanga okunyaragania mu Dekapoori,
amangʼana amakuru gano Yeesu amukoreeri. Abhaatu bhoosi bhakaruguura.
Yeesu arahorya omukari no okuryoora omuukya
Yeesu na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakaambuka enyaanza no obhwaato okukyoora kumwaambuko. Hano bhaahikiri, esaango ekuru ya abhaatu ekamwiikumanira embarika we enyaanza.
Hayo akaaza omukaangati wumwe we enyuumba ye esaango, eriina ryaaye Yairo. Hano yamuruuzi Yeesu, akamugyaku, akamuhigamira embere waaye.
Akamukumiirirya akubhuga, “Omuukya waane ni murweeri, ari haguhi kukwa. Ndasabha tugye, omutuurire amabhoko gaazo kumubhiri gwaaye, okubha ahore.”
Yeesu akagya nawe. Esaango yirya ekuru yaari ekumutuniirira, emwiiruguuriri bhukongʼu.
Musaango yirya, yaarimu omukari wuno yaari no obhurweeri bhwo obhureegu kwe emyaaka ikumi ne ebhiri.
Omukari wuyo, yaari anyaakiri bhukongʼu kugya kubhagabhu bhaaru. Akamara ebhigiro bhyaaye bhyoosi akabha arahira kubhagabhu, nawe obhurweeri bhwaaye bhutaasuuhiri, nawe bhukaaruha.
Hano omukari wuyo yiigwiiri gano Yeesu akoriri, akiigaambira, “Ndaakunieku omweenda gwaaye ego, ndahora.” Niho akahita musaango ya abhaatu kwiinyuma, akakuniaku omweenda gwa Yeesu.
Hayohayo amanyiinga gakatinika, akiiyiigwa mumubhiri kubha ahoriri.
Rugeendo rumwe, Yeesu akamenya kubha amanaga gaaye gakoriri emirimo. Akiikibhuka, akabhabhuurya abhaatu bhe esaango, “Ni weewi wuno akunirye omweenda gwaane?”
Abhaanabheega bhaaye bhakamubhuurira, “Orarora abhaatu bhaaru bhakwiisaanga owaazo! Ndora orabhuurya, ‘Ni weewi wuno anikuniryeku?’ ”
Nawe akarora eno ne eno, okubha amurore wuno akamukuniaku.
Niho omukari wurya akoobhoha,
akaaza no okamuhigamira embere waaye, eno ararigita, kwo okubha akamenya gano gakorirwe kweewe. Akamubhuurira obhuheene bhwoosi.
Yeesu akamubhuurira, “Muukya waane, obhwiikirirya bhwaazo bhukuhonirye! Ogye no omureembe, bhoono ohoniibhwe.”

Hano Yeesu yaari akyaakeerenia no omukari wuyo, abhaatu bhakaaza okurwa mumugye gwa Yairo, omukaangati we enyuumba ye esaango, bhakabhuga, “Yairo, omuukya waazo amariri kukwa. Kwaki orageenderera kumunyaakya omweegya?”
Nawe hano Yeesu yiigwiiri amangʼana gaabhu, akamubhuurira Yairo, “Otoobhoha, obhe no obhwiikirirya.”
Yeesu akabharekya abhaatu abhaandi bhoosi kubha bhatakaangatania neewe. Akagya na Petero, Yaakobo na Yohana wamwaabhu Yaakobo.
Hano bhaahikiri munyuumba ya Yairo, Yeesu akabhona abhaatu bhararira no okwaaramira.
Akasikira munyuumba, akabhuga, “Ndora murarira no okutema ekituri? Omuukya wuno akyaari kukwa, nawe ahiindiiri.”

Abhaatu bhakamuseka kwo okurega, niho Yeesu akabhahurukya bhoosi igutu. Nawe akamugega wiise no omuukya hamwe na nina waabhu na abhaanabheega bhaaye bhatatu bhano akaaza nabho, bhakasikira mukyuumba kino bhaari bhamuhiindiirye omuukya wuyo.
Akamugwaata omuukya wuyo kwo okubhoko, akamubhuurira, “Tarita, koomu!” obhugazuro bhwaku, “Muukya, bhuuka!”
Hayohayo, omuukya wuyo akiimeerera, akataanga kugeenda. Ewe yaari ne emyaaka ikumi ne ebhiri. Bhano bhaari hamwe na Yeesu bhakaruguura bhukongʼu.
Yeesu akabharekya bhatabhuurira muutu wuyo woosi gano gaatuukiri. Kyaamwe, akabhabhuurira abhiibhuri bho omuukya wuyo bhamuhe ebhyaakurya.

footnotes.text: Yaari ni nyaangi ya Abhayahudi okubhiika mumabhigi gano gaari mubhiguru, agaandi bhaari bharatuka abheene.
Dekapoori ku Kiyunaani obhugazuro bhwaku ni migye ikumi. Mukyaaro kiyo, Abhayunaani bhahiikara abheene ego, bhatari Abhayahudi.

Omukari wurya akoobhoha kwo okubha Abhayahudi bhakabhaahura abhakari bhano bhakurwa amanyiinga kubha makire. Bhatiikiririibhwe ne emigiro gya Musa okwiikumanirya hamwe na abhaandi. Omuutu yaangabhakuniryeku, neewe yaarabha makire kweeki. Rora Abharaawi 15:25-33.
